message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        ruby: [2.7, '3.0', 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, head, truffleruby-head]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Sets up the Ruby version
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
        bundler-cache: true

    - name: Sets up the environment
      run: |
        sudo apt-get install libsqlite3-dev

    - name: Install legacy bundler for Ruby 2.7
      if: ${{ matrix.ruby == 2.7 }}
      run: |
        gem install -q bundler -v 2.4.22

    - name: Install bundler 2.7+ for modern Rubies
      if: ${{ matrix.ruby != 2.7 }}
      run: |
        gem install -q bundler

    - name: Run bundle install
      run: |
        bundle install

    - name: Runs code QA and tests
      run: bundle exec rake

    - name: Publish to Rubygems
      continue-on-error: true
      if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}
      run: |
        mkdir -p $HOME/.gem
        touch $HOME/.gem/credentials
        chmod 0600 $HOME/.gem/credentials
        printf -- "---\n:rubygems_api_key: Bearer ${GEM_HOST_API_KEY}\n" > $HOME/.gem/credentials
        gem build *.gemspec
        gem push *.gem
      env:
        GEM_HOST_API_KEY: ${{secrets.RUBYGEMS_AUTH_TOKEN}}",
  "rationale": "Add Bundler dependency caching by enabling ruby/setup-ruby's bundler-cache option. The workflow runs `bundle install` on every matrix job with no cache, so gems are re-fetched and re-installed repeatedly across runs and Ruby versions. Enabling bundler-cache caches the installed gems keyed by the lockfile/Ruby environment while keeping every installation, test, QA, and publish step intact, so build and test coverage is preserved. This matches the dependency-cache mechanism (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) and the measured Ruby/Bundler experiment that reported elapsed-time savings from caching gems.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2"]
}
